remarks: This wonderful 3 bed, 3 bath townhome offers wonderful living in an excellent location. Entering into a flowing open floor plan, the living room with modern fireplace and wood floors, leads into a gourmet kitchen, with stainless appliances and granite counter tops, as well as dining area and bonus sunroom, which can be used as an office or den. On this level there is second bonus room with mezzanine/ loft area, again can be used as an office , studio, extra room. A central staircase with a large skylight, leads to upper floor bedrooms and roof deck. The master suite has a balcony, fireplace and two good sized closets. A highlight of the property, is the expansive roof deck, with city views,
